asset_heavy.reason: Hospice care and plumbing service run on vans, branches and staff; franchising and home-based care need little heavy capital.

big_ticket.reason: Hospice days of care and plumbing or drain-cleaning calls are routine, small-to-moderate, frequent service transactions.

cyclical_demand.reason: Hospice care is medical and Medicare-funded; emergency plumbing and drain cleaning are needed repairs that are hard to postpone.

large_customers.reason: VITAS serves patients paid by Medicare; Roto-Rooter serves homeowners and small businesses, so main customers are not large enterprises.

notes: VITAS (hospice) is the larger segment by revenue; Roto-Rooter is the other segment. Government pays for hospice, but patients receive the care.

offers_products.reason: Revenue comes from hospice care and plumbing/drain services; franchise and parts are incidental.

offers_services.reason: VITAS hospice care and Roto-Rooter plumbing, drain cleaning and water cleanup are services.

people_delivered.reason: Hospice care by nurses, physicians and aides, plus technician-delivered plumbing work, depends on staff time and skill.

recurring_revenue.reason: Hospice is the larger part; it is episodic care per patient, and Roto-Rooter is mostly one-off service calls.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Hospice patients and families, and homeowners calling Roto-Rooter, are the main buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Roto-Rooter serves commercial customers and municipalities; Medicare pays for VITAS, but patients are the buyers.
